Press Release


### Comscore to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


**RESTON, VA, Oct 26, 2026** – Comscore, Inc. (Nasdaq: SCOR), a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media, today announced that it plans to hold a conference call to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Tuesday November 3rd at 5:00 p.m. ET.


Interested parties may access the conference call via live webcast at[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/gf3tn5xm](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/gf3tn5xm__;!!O_jdeSOxYy8!MwB7XHGC7AjXhxVf_xhDUXjCFh36ECabGFWF9gjyIq-Bm_xh2Ncwy3HAvuKKo0RGKPiO7LfzFRwxEcIFFkwPYkEdVEV1Kw%24) or participate via telephone by registering in advance at[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIf2473d7e7d144aceb23cb6312d24d732](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIf2473d7e7d144aceb23cb6312d24d732__;!!O_jdeSOxYy8!MwB7XHGC7AjXhxVf_xhDUXjCFh36ECabGFWF9gjyIq-Bm_xh2Ncwy3HAvuKKo0RGKPiO7LfzFRwxEcIFFkwPYkHjQlxyhA%24) .


Upon registration, all telephone participants will receive the dial-in number along with a unique PIN number that can be used to access the call.


Following the conference call, a replay will be available via webcast at[https://ir.comscore.com/events-presentations](https://ir.comscore.com/events-presentations) .


**About Comscore**


Comscore is a trusted global partner for planning, activating, and evaluating media across platforms. Its unmatched data footprint brings together Connected TV (CTV), digital, national and local linear TV intelligence with advanced audience insights to help media buyers and sellers understand how audiences engage across screens and make business decisions with confidence. Comscore is a preeminent provider of independent, comprehensive cross-platform measurement and decisioning solutions designed to improve outcomes at scale.
